title: Beyond the Name: Demographic Leakage in De-Identified Résumés and Evaluation Artifacts in LLM Bias Audits

bias_targets.methodology: Using counterfactual résumés that hold declared language fields strictly identical while injecting unstructured prose (e.g., community involvement and interests) associated with five distinct ethnocultural groups (Anglo, First Nations, Chinese, Indian, Vietnamese) to evaluate model recoverability, pairwise hiring preferences, and downstream shortlisting outcomes.

Comparing model choices in pairwise LLM-as-a-judge scenarios across forward and reversed presentation orders to determine if selection rates are driven by the candidate's position and forced-choice constraints rather than genuine demographic preference.
